title: Sharp CR Beckner-Onofri inequalities under high-order holomorphic moment constraints
summary: We establish sharp Beckner--Onofri on the CR sphere $\mathbb{S}^{2N-1}\subset\mathbb C^N$, $N\ge2$, under vanishing holomorphic moments through degree $m\ge1$. The optimal coefficients are $\frac{1}{m+1}$. The function inequality admits a stronger form involving only the energy above degree $m$. We also prove a quantitative concentration estimate in the $1$-Wasserstein distance and show that every maximizing sequence has diverging energy and approaches the family of uniform measures on regular $(m+1)$-polygons.
